counting_notes: Gameplay types, model families, appearances, and production actions are deliberately separate counts.
STONE is a texture-only petrification/helper family and is not counted as a character model.
High-detail geometry signatures combine the exact hashes of each appearance's highest-detail body/component meshes; exact shared geometry collapses to one signature.
The 61 appearance rows classify into 42 masters, 9 major derivatives, and 10 skin-only variants.
Duplicate/component aliases and unresolved definitions are gameplay-type counts and do not add to the 61 evidenced visible appearances.

limitations: The executable-side numeric type-to-model pointer table remains undecoded, so name/archive co-occurrence mappings are HIGH confidence unless an exact prior recovery exists.
PSW multiweighted geometry is hashed and inventoried but not topology-decoded by the current bounded PSQ tool.
Equipment labels are conservative inventory-level classifications; unknown is retained where binary attachment semantics are not established.
The Amazon types 38/39 are packaged in LEVEL08 without a matching AMAZON model family and remain unresolved.
Twenty-five global type definitions never occur in audited campaign/arena CHAR_TYPES tables; some are aliases or unused code paths rather than visible characters.
